description: This file is an HTML document for a web-based database visualizer interface. It contains structure, styles, and JavaScript code to connect to backend APIs to list databases, tables, and display data with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database details, loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a specific table and renders it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
